response.sql: WITH fee_details AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, (feerate - rebrate) as net_fee_rate FROM fees), order_level_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fee_rate FROM fee_details GROUP BY orderslink), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) as overall_avg_net_fee_rate FROM fee_details), above_average AS (SELECT o.avg_rebtotal, o.avg_net_fee_rate, (o.avg_net_fee_rate - oa.overall_avg_net_fee_rate) as excess FROM order_level_stats o CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE o.avg_net_fee_rate > oa.overall_avg_net_fee_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebtotal, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_average
